budget_items.topic: Warrants signed by the chair on behalf of the BOS
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Alonzo announced he signed payroll and accounts payable warrants and a deductions warrant.
The auditor said the town ended FY2019 with a surplus against a budgeted decrease; revenues ran over budget and expenses under, with state and county charges the only overexpenditure.
budget_items.quote: you ended the year with a surplus of $12,000 even though you had budgeted a decrease of $663,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The auditor reported general stabilization of 1.9 million dollars, a zoning stabilization fund and a vehicle equipment stabilization fund.
budget_items.quote: you have a zoning stabilization fund with $229,000 in it and you also have a vehicle equipment stabilization fund with $644,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town has short-term debt outstanding for the school construction project, to be paid off when the final MSBA payment is received; any remaining need may be long-term debt.
budget_items.quote: you have 2.1 million dollars in short term debt outstanding and that was for the school construction project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town expended federal funds above the single audit threshold, mostly on education grants and school lunches.
budget_items.quote: the town expended $835,000; $173,000 was on school lunches and $630,000 was on education grants.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The auditor found outstanding vendor checks more than three months old in the bank reconciliation and recommended a written policy.
budget_items.quote: checks greater than three months old totaling $125,270, some going back to 2010

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The board voted in 2019 to write off uncollectible ambulance receivables, reducing the balance; most of the remainder is over 180 days old.
budget_items.quote: increased by$16,000 in 2018 and totaled $760,000 at year-end.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Unitil announced it committed money to a customer assistance fund and to other COVID-19 programs.
budget_items.quote: unitil has committed $150,000 to this fund, plus an additional $75,000 to covid-19 related programs at the united way

budget_items.quote: funds towards the purchase of hybrid police cruisers

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town's state grants toward the purchase of the Saliba property will not be extended; closing is expected in May. No dollar figure printed.
